<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>SEBI regulatory overhaul:</strong> The regulator has proposed major changes to derivatives settlement and closing auction timings, offering multiple framework options to enhance market efficiency.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Crude and yield headwinds:</strong> Brent crude prices nearing $110 and US 10-year yields approaching 5% have triggered a sell-off in Indian equities, causing the Sensex and Nifty to decline for the fifth consecutive week.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxOR1MtdjRnQmY5eDQ4SGhWdnkyaEhXLWJyUFVoNkhKcFlCd2ZVSlhENGI2d2lMSUFsd0ZJZlhROUZncnNGZW44aHRFUFhNaUZ4LTg5b0lfZVNxU1pFcFV2Q0MzVE9JNDJOOTUxdUdIbEFqLTJoeFE3TFJYTkl5Snk1OGpybjJldjlFM1ZFMS1IeVVvcVI5RjlMVmdoalRJRmVVaGxBZHdleFd0ZTN4VVlhcW8wS1pkcEpzMDJWeg?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Rupee and monetary pressure:</strong> The Indian rupee has weakened to 95.55 against the dollar, driven by geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and persistent US Fed rate hike expectations.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
</ul>
